data.name: Send a transactional email
data.evaluateGuide:
Sends a transactional email through Brevo’s SMTP email endpoint. Agents can deliver a message to specified recipients using a transactional payload.
Use for: sending an email, delivering a notification, sending a receipt
Not supported: email activity retrieval, batch delivery, campaign management

data.name: Send a single send transactional email asynchronously.
data.description: Asynchronously send a transactional email. Returns the status of the email send with a statusId that can be used to continuously query for the status using the Email Send Status API.
data.evaluateGuide:
Queues one transactional email for asynchronous delivery through HubSpot. The response includes a status identifier for later delivery-status checks.
Use for: sending one email, queueing asynchronous delivery, sending a transactional notification
Not supported: bulk sending, contact management, status retrieval

data.name: Send a single email
data.description: Queue a single email for delivery. Requires email.send permission.
data.evaluateGuide:
Queues one email for delivery through Sendmux. Agents can submit a single outbound message when the email.send permission is available.
Use for: sending one email, queueing delivery, sending a notification
Not supported: batch delivery, inbox retrieval, email analytics

data.name: Send a batch of emails
data.description: Queue up to 100 emails for delivery in a single request. Uses partial success model — individual message failures do not fail the entire batch. Requires email.send permission.
data.evaluateGuide:
Queues up to 100 emails for delivery through Sendmux, allowing individual message failures without failing the entire batch. The email.send permission is required.
Use for: batch email delivery, sending notifications, queuing bulk messages
Not supported: single-message status lookup, inbox retrieval, email analytics

data.name: Get all your transactional email activity (unaggregated events)
data.description: This endpoint will show the aggregated stats for past 30 days by default if startDate and endDate OR days is not passed. The date range can not exceed 90 days
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves unaggregated transactional email activity from Brevo for a selected period, with a default recent range when no range is supplied. Agents can inspect delivery events and filter by message identifier.
Use for: reviewing email events, checking delivery activity, filtering message activity
Not supported: sending email, batch delivery, campaign management
